ticket.subject: Verifying webhook signatures
ticket.body: Hi, we are setting up a webhook endpoint for invoice.paid events. How can we confirm that requests actually come from Ledgerline? And what happens if our server is down for a few hours, do we lose the events? We are on the Growth plan and our developer would like to get this right the first time before we go live next week.

note: Signature verification and retry policy in webhooks.
